description: Plain is a B2B customer support platform built on its own public GraphQL API.
auth_notes: A machine user and API key are created and scoped with fine-grained permissions; a third-party profile says keys are sent as bearer credentials.
gate_detail: Plans are priced per member seat; every plan starts with a 7-day no-card free trial. No free plan is described, and the sources do not say whether API keys work during the trial or on every tier.
api_scope: Core GraphQL API, same as the product is built on, covering customers, companies, threads, help center, labels, tiers and SLAs, plus TypeScript and Go SDKs.
mcp_notes: A third-party profile lists a remote Plain MCP server (mcp.plain.com); no Plain-owned source confirms it, so status is left unknown.
blocker_detail: Plain is sold per member seat after a 7-day trial; no free plan shown, and API access by tier is not stated.
